observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A dimly lit club or lounge with retro decor, a bar counter shaped like a snake, artwork on walls, and later an Egyptian-themed set with golden gramophone and columns
observation.dancers: Large group of mixed men and women dancing in social club settings, plus Batman and female partner
observation.formation_and_space: Unstructured crowd moving individually or in small pairs across the floor, spacing shifts naturally
observation.posture: Upright torso, relaxed knees, weight shifting side to side
observation.footwork: Stepping side to side or bouncing lightly in place on the beat; lower legs and specific heel-toe action partially obscured by crowd
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms bent at elbows with hands held near head level or in front of shoulders, waving or gesturing side to side; some partners holding hands
observation.hips_and_torso: Subtle hip swaying and torso twisting matching the arm movements
observation.partnering: Some solo dancing and some casual partner dancing side by side holding hands without tight frame
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Standing level mostly, with occasional playful leaps or jumps by Batman in character
observation.costume_and_props: Partygoers in 1960s cocktail dresses and suits; Batman in full superhero costume with cape and cowl; female partner in red fringe dress
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and weight transfer cannot be clearly seen due to camera distance and crowd occlusion
